title: Source Credibility Checker — Overview and definition
body: Public edition. Public tool knowledge, fact-checked reference. Evaluates an author's expertise and a source's reliability. The Source Credibility Checker evaluates an author's expertise and source reliability. It checks the author's credentials and publication history, the publisher's reputation and peer-review process, the date and whether the information is current, and whether claims are supported by evidence. The result is a clear reliability rating with the reasons behind it.
capabilities: Check author credentials and publication history
Evaluate publisher reputation and review process
Check whether the information is current
Verify claims are backed by evidence
Produce a reliability rating with reasons

demo.code: const paras=['Sleep consolidates memory.','REM sleep aids procedural learning.','Naps improve afternoon recall.'];const brief=paras.map(p=>p.split('.')[0]+'.');J({sentences:brief.length,first:brief[0]});assert(brief.length===3&&brief[0]==='Sleep consolidates memory.','summarize');
